content_html:
Located in the middle of the Ica desert, Huacachina It is an oasis that seems straight out of a dream. During the day, its waters reflect the enormous golden dunes, but when night falls, the desert takes on a different energy: the sky is filled with stars, the wind blows through the sands and local stories come to life.

Night adrenaline: Sandboarding and buggies in the desert

One of the most exciting experiences in Huacachina is touring the desert in a buggy tour. These all-terrain vehicles cross the dunes at full speed, going up and down as if it were a natural roller coaster. The feeling of freedom and adrenaline is indescribable, especially when the sun has already set and the only illumination comes from the moon and headlights.

After the buggy tour, the adventure continues with the night sandboarding. Sliding down the dunes under a starry sky is a unique experience. You can do it standing up, like snowboarding, or lying down, which increases speed and excitement.

Legends and mysteries of the oasis

Huacachina is not only an adventure destination, but also a place full of mysteries and legends. The most famous is the story of the Huacachina mermaid. It is said that many years ago, a beautiful young woman fell in love with a warrior, but their love was interrupted by war. After the death of her lover, she cried so much that her tears formed the lagoon, and the spirit of the mermaid still inhabits its waters. Some locals claim that, on the quietest nights, you can hear their cries and that the lagoon has a mystical power.

An unforgettable night under the stars

After the thrill of sandboarding and the stories that make your skin crawl, many travelers stay in the dunes to enjoy a breathtaking view of the sky. Far from the light pollution of the city, the stars shine brightly, and it is possible to see the Milky Way in all its splendor. Some tours even include campfires, where you can share stories and enjoy a more intimate and special experience.

Tips to enjoy the experience

  • Wear comfortable clothes and a light jacket, as nights in the desert can be cold.
  • Use sunscreen, even if you go in the afternoon, because the sun in Ica is strong.
  • Don't forget glasses and scarf to protect you from sand when traveling by buggy.
  • Book in advance, especially in high season, since night tours are in high demand.

If you are looking for an adventure full of emotion, mystery and natural beauty, Huacachina at night is an experience that you cannot miss.
